# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: notification-service.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: notification-service
  team: platform
  tier: standard
spec:
  type: worker
  slos:
    job-success-rate:
      target: 99.5
      window: 30d
    processing-time-p95:
      target: 95.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: notification-queue
    type: queue
    critical: true
  ownership:
    team: platform
